title: Granular IAM Filtering and Search-As-You-Type Tuning
summary: Discovery Engine adds resource-level IAM filtering for Gemini Enterprise and dynamic search-as-you-type scoring overrides. Alpha users also gain support for file attachments in long-running agent tasks.
details: A new `resourceAccessControlConfig` has been added to `ProjectCustomerProvidedConfig`. When `dataStoreAccessControlEnabled` is set to true, Gemini Enterprise users will only see data stores and connectors for which they have explicit resource-level `.get` IAM permissions. For search optimization, `SearchRequest` now supports `SearchAsYouTypeSpec`, allowing developers to override data-store-level configurations per request. This includes specifying which `fields` to score, assigning them custom `weight` values, and setting a `scoreThreshold` for real-time result filtering. Additionally, the `v1alpha` API now supports `userSuppliedSobiArtifactReference` within `QueryPart`, enabling file attachments for long-running agent (Sobi) tasks with metadata for filenames and MIME types.
